chapterInfo.content:
52
Nhyia no ho siesie
1O Sion, nyane ɛ, nyane ɛ!
hyɛ w’ahoɔden!
O Yerusalem, kuro kronkron,
hyɛ w’animuonyam atadeɛ!
na momonotoni ne deɛ ne ho nteɛ biara
renkɔ so nhyɛne wo mu bio.
2Yerusalem, sɔre porepore wo ho mfuturo gu!
O Yerusalem a wɔafa wo dommum;
Sion babaa a wɔafa wo dommum,
sanesane wo kɔn mu nkyehoma!
3 # Yes 50.1 Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Wɔantɔn mo annye hwee, na ɛnyɛ sika na wɔde bɛgye mo. 4Na sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka nie: Me man siane kɔɔ Misraim akane no kɔyɛɛ hɔ ahɔhoɔ, na Asiria nso hyɛɛ wɔn so kwa. 5#Hes 36.20 Na afei, ɛdeɛn na mewɔ meyɛ no ha, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔafa me man kwa yi? Wɔn a wɔdi wɔn soɔ no twa adwo, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔka me din ho abususɛm daa daa nyinaa. 6Saa nti me man bɛhunu me din, saa nti da no ara wɔbɛhunu sɛ me ara mene deɛ ɔka sɛ: Menie.
Wɔn a wɔagye wɔn no saneba
7 # Nah 1.15; Rom 10.15; Sak 9.9 Sɛdeɛ obi a ɔnam mmepɔ soɔ ka asɛmpa no
nan si yɛ fɛ fa!
Ɔno na ɔka asomdwoeɛsɛm, ɔka papa ho asɛmpa,
ɔma wɔte nkwagyeɛ asɛm,
na ɔka kyerɛ Sion sɛ: Wo Nyankopɔn di hene!
8 # Yes 56.10; 62.6; Hes 3.17 Tie! w’awɛmfoɔ bom ma wɔn nne so
to ahurisie dwom;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ani tua
AWURADE sɛ ɔresane aba Sion.
9Yerusalem amamfo,
mommom nto anigyeɛ dwom,
na AWURADE akyekyere ne man werɛ,
wagye Yerusalem.
10 # Yes 53.1 AWURADE ayi ne basa kronkron no ho,
amanaman nyinaa anim,
na asase ano nyinaa ahunu
yɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagyeɛ.
11 # Yes 48.20; 2 Ko 6.17 Montwe mo ho, montwe mo ho mfiri hɔ nkɔ,
monnka adeɛ a ɛho nteɛ;
momfiri adi mfiri ne mu, monte mo ho,
mo a mosoa AWURADE nnwinneɛ no.
12 # Eks 12.11 Na ɛnyɛ ɛherɛ so na mobɛfiri adie,
na ɛnyɛ dwane so na mobɛnanteɛ,
na AWURADE redi mo anim,
na Israel Nyankopɔn abɔ mo kyidɔm.
Nyankopɔn akoa no amanehunu
13 # Yes 42.1 Hwɛ, m’akoa bɛdi yie,
wɔbɛpagya, na wɔama no so
na wakorɔn sɛ.
14Sɛdeɛ ne ho yɛɛ nnipa pii ahodwirie no,
ɛsiane sɛ n’anim asɛe a ɛnte sɛ onipa deɛ,
na ne nipaban nte sɛ nnipa mma deɛ bio no nti,
15 # Yes 65.1; Rom 15.21 saa ara na ɔbɛma amanaman pii abobɔ pirie,
na ahemfo amuamua wɔn ano wɔ ne ho,
ɛfiri sɛ deɛ wɔnka nkyerɛɛ wɔn no, wɔhunu,
na deɛ wɔntee da no, wɔte aseɛ.

O Sion, nyane ɛ, nyane ɛ!
hyɛ w’ahoɔden!
O Yerusalem, kuro kronkron,
hyɛ w’animuonyam atadeɛ!
na momonotoni ne deɛ ne ho nteɛ biara
renkɔ so nhyɛne wo mu bio.
Yerusalem, sɔre porepore wo ho mfuturo gu!
O Yerusalem a wɔafa wo dommum;
Sion babaa a wɔafa wo dommum,
sanesane wo kɔn mu nkyehoma!
Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Wɔantɔn mo annye hwee, na ɛnyɛ sika na wɔde bɛgye mo. Na sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka nie: Me man siane kɔɔ Misraim akane no kɔyɛɛ hɔ ahɔhoɔ, na Asiria nso hyɛɛ wɔn so kwa. Na afei, ɛdeɛn na mewɔ meyɛ no ha, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔafa me man kwa yi? Wɔn a wɔdi wɔn soɔ no twa adwo, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔka me din ho abususɛm daa daa nyinaa. Saa nti me man bɛhunu me din, saa nti da no ara wɔbɛhunu sɛ me ara mene deɛ ɔka sɛ: Menie.

Sɛdeɛ obi a ɔnam mmepɔ soɔ ka asɛmpa no
nan si yɛ fɛ fa!
Ɔno na ɔka asomdwoeɛsɛm, ɔka papa ho asɛmpa,
ɔma wɔte nkwagyeɛ asɛm,
na ɔka kyerɛ Sion sɛ: Wo Nyankopɔn di hene!
Tie! w’awɛmfoɔ bom ma wɔn nne so
to ahurisie dwom;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ani tua
AWURADE sɛ ɔresane aba Sion.
Yerusalem amamfo,
mommom nto anigyeɛ dwom,
na AWURADE akyekyere ne man werɛ,
wagye Yerusalem.
AWURADE ayi ne basa kronkron no ho,
amanaman nyinaa anim,
na asase ano nyinaa ahunu
yɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagyeɛ.
Montwe mo ho, montwe mo ho mfiri hɔ nkɔ,
monnka adeɛ a ɛho nteɛ;
momfiri adi mfiri ne mu, monte mo ho,
mo a mosoa AWURADE nnwinneɛ no.
Na ɛnyɛ ɛherɛ so na mobɛfiri adie,
na ɛnyɛ dwane so na mobɛnanteɛ,
na AWURADE redi mo anim,
na Israel Nyankopɔn abɔ mo kyidɔm.

Hwɛ, m’akoa bɛdi yie,
wɔbɛpagya, na wɔama no so
na wakorɔn sɛ.
Sɛdeɛ ne ho yɛɛ nnipa pii ahodwirie no,
ɛsiane sɛ n’anim asɛe a ɛnte sɛ onipa deɛ,
na ne nipaban nte sɛ nnipa mma deɛ bio no nti,
saa ara na ɔbɛma amanaman pii abobɔ pirie,
na ahemfo amuamua wɔn ano wɔ ne ho,
ɛfiri sɛ deɛ wɔnka nkyerɛɛ wɔn no, wɔhunu,
na deɛ wɔntee da no, wɔte aseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
